name: centry-ifici-planner
description:
Screen initial IFICI facts, identify routes to investigate and build an editable evidence pack with document references. Distinguishes potential routes, missing proof, exclusions and matters for the competent authority; no application is submitted.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

No IFICI approval or eligibility confirmation, registry verification or filing. Prior NHR remains an exclusion; regional implementation and registration dates need case-specific validation. Screening prepares evidence and questions; it never confirms eligibility, professional classification, entity status or approval. Regional implementation, route-specific notices, registration deadlines and continuing compliance need case-specific validation. Pasted text only; no OCR/PDF verification, employer registry lookup, portal authentication or application submission.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

defaultPrompt: I am moving to Portugal for a software role. Could IFICI apply?
Help me prepare the documents my adviser needs for IFICI.

positive.prompt: Open Centry IFICI Planner to organise Portugal IFICI route questions and evidence before professional review.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Centry IFICI Planner workspace. Return productId ifici-planner, kind open, required input questions and scope limitations. Do not insert fictional customer facts or require a booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry IFICI Planner: Screen initial IFICI facts, identify routes to investigate and build an editable evidence pack with document references. Distinguishes potential routes, missing proof, exclusions and matters for the competent authority; no application is submitted. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
